# Amy McPherson

> Amy McPherson is a Product Designer at Canva, based in Melbourne, Australia. Amy McPherson is a Product Designer at Canva in Melbourne. Portfolio of product design, digital design and UX/UI case studies: AI landing page tooling, design systems, conversion-focused B2B SaaS design and accessible web design.

Open to conversations about product design, digital design and UX/UI design roles. Contact: amy.mcph.95@gmail.com. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/amy-mcpherson-6662a9131/

## Skills and focus

- Product design
- Digital design
- UX/UI design
- Design systems
- Landing page optimisation
- AI product design
- Conversion-focused design
- B2B SaaS design
- Accessibility (WCAG AAA)

## Case studies

- [Canva QuickPage AI](https://amymcpherson.design/work/canva-quickpage-ai): Case study: how Amy McPherson, Product Designer at Canva, took QuickPage AI (QPAI) from a hackathon idea to an AI landing page builder with its own team, turning a brief into a buildable page in minutes.
- [Higher Education at Canva](https://amymcpherson.design/work/canva-higher-education): Case study: how Amy McPherson, Product Designer at Canva, redesigned the Canva for Higher Education landing page for buyers and created a new Faculty page, improving lead quality for Sales.
- [Contacting Sales at Canva](https://amymcpherson.design/work/canva-contact-sales): Case study: how Amy McPherson, Product Designer at Canva, redesigned the Contact Sales form as a two-step flow, driving a statistically significant +6.3% lift in submissions without hurting lead quality.
- [Envato x Adobe Express](https://amymcpherson.design/work/envato-x-adobe-express): Case study: how Amy McPherson, Senior Digital Designer at Envato, designed the Envato x Adobe Express competition landing page that explained the rules and drove strong entries.
- [Play Tennis](https://amymcpherson.design/work/play-tennis): Case study: how Amy McPherson redesigned the Play Tennis website for Tennis Australia and built an AAA-accessible design system with playful animated assets.
- [UpGuard](https://amymcpherson.design/work/upguard): Case study: how Amy McPherson designed UpGuard's Vendor Risk campaign landing page and refreshed the brand with a brighter, more human visual language and a scalable card-based design system.
- [Local Agent Finder](https://amymcpherson.design/work/local-agent-finder): Case study: how Amy McPherson redesigned the Local Agent Finder end-to-end flow around trust, transparency and momentum to help more homeowners connect with a real estate agent.
- [Antiglum App](https://amymcpherson.design/work/antiglum-app): Case study: how Amy McPherson designed the brand, UX/UI and website for Antiglum, a deliberately campy brutalist app made to beat Melbourne lockdown boredom.
- [Ross Thompson Furniture](https://amymcpherson.design/work/ross-thompson-furniture-website): Case study: how Amy McPherson rebranded Ross Thompson Furniture, from logo and business cards to collateral and a Squarespace website for handcrafted furniture.
